description: Focused checks for Lifecycle relationship previews, active X-rays, communication history, compressed timelines, and responsive graph behavior.

items.name: Suggested Lifecycle relationship graph is populated
items.description: Test: Open Lifecycle, choose Suggested, then Relationship view. Pass: A relationship preview appears for every suggested agent, workflow, group, and community inspection; the graph is not an empty shell; each preview shows its object type, inspection focus, time window, and target-required state.

items.name: Suggested Lifecycle list stays focused on catalog cards
items.description: Test: In Lifecycle > Suggested, switch between Grid, Detail, and List views without using Use. Pass: Suggested views show catalog entries and their actions only; no agent or workflow X-ray is rendered until an inspection is used and a target is selected under Active or Archived.

items.name: Active Lifecycle X-rays show agent and workflow history
items.description: Test: Use an agent inspection and a workflow inspection, select targets, and open Active in List and Relationship views. Pass: Agents show files, conversations, models, and configuration events; workflows show definition, status, runs, participants, and artifacts; selecting a target opens its X-ray with a collapsible evidence panel.

items.name: Group and community communication history is inspectable
items.description: Test: Use the group and community communication suggestions, select one available group and community, then open their Active X-rays. Pass: Each target shows message activity and archive counts, its relationship lane identifies the communication type, and full message content remains in Communications rather than leaking into Lifecycle.

items.name: Lifecycle timelines preserve time relationships
items.description: Test: Open Relationship view for targets with events separated by short and long gaps. Pass: Events remain ordered with larger gaps visibly larger but compressed, long quiet periods show an ellipsis and duration, and event labels remain readable without forcing an enormous empty timeline.

items.name: Lifecycle graphs and X-rays work on mobile
items.description: Test: At an iPhone-width viewport, use Suggested Relationship and Active Relationship views, zoom the graph, select a node, and expand or collapse an X-ray. Pass: The page does not overflow, graph scrolling stays inside its container, zoom controls remain tappable, labels do not overlap, and the X-ray content scrolls independently.

items.name: Lifecycle selections and evidence survive restart
items.description: Test: Use one Lifecycle inspection for each supported target type, refresh the browser, restart the instance, and return to Lifecycle. Pass: Active records, selected targets, graph/list view choice, collapsed X-ray state, and available evidence remain consistent after restart; missing targets show a clear error instead of a blank page.
